<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/check-name"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Reports whether a login name is already taken.

Names are unique across the whole service rather than within your organization, so a name can be
unavailable even though you have never used it. Call this before creating or renaming a
credential to avoid either.

A small set of reserved names — `admin`, `root`, `support` and similar — always report as
taken. Note that the two cases fail differently when you go on to use the name: one already in
use returns `422`, whereas a reserved one is rejected by validation with `400`.

It is a `POST` because the name travels in the body rather than the URL, which keeps it out of
logs and browser history. Nothing is created.
